column1: # Boards that moved provider *and* changed slug, so the same-slug search in
# scripts/validate/relocate_dead_boards.py cannot find them. Researched from each company's own
# careers page, then probed before writing (`--moves`); a line here is a hypothesis, not a fact.
# old_ats  old_slug  new_ats  new_slug
greenhouse  aerospike                     rippling  aerospike-inc   # ats.rippling.com/aerospike-inc/jobs
greenhouse  affinity                      ashby     affinity.co     # Ashby slugs may contain a dot
greenhouse  alleghenysciencetechnology    ashby     alleghenyst     # alleghenyst.com; the longer domain is parked
ashby       attentivemobile               greenhouse attentive      # Attentive: cross-ATS *and* renamed
ashby       atomicsemi                    ashby     fab2            # Atomic Semi renamed to Fab2
ashby       august                        ashby     august-health   # same ATS, hyphenated slug
ashby       accelevents                   workable  accelevents     # same slug, provider changed
# Researched but deliberately NOT applied:
#   greenhouse:ascendanalytics -> bamboohr:ascendanalytics
#       BambooHR has no scraper, so recording it live would promise a Board we cannot read.
#   greenhouse:aurorainnovation -> ashby (private org)
#       Hiring (~100 roles) but the Ashby org slug is not publicly derivable; seven guesses 404'd.
#       Their own aurora.tech/api/jobs-index serves the full set if a one-off is ever wanted.
#   greenhouse:ast -> greenhouse:astspacemobile
#       Ambiguous: "AST" is also Allegheny Science & Technology, separately in this batch. A lead.
#   greenhouse:attune -> greenhouse:pinnacolassurance
#       That is the parent (Pinnacol), a different legal entity — it would mis-attribute the jobs.
#   greenhouse:ascend -> greenhouse:ascend21
#       Two live boards match the name (ascend21, ascendtogether); which one is unresolved.
